note: Plan piece S6. Accept/decline is real on both apps (ProviderRequestsView on iOS; a booking is written PENDING until the salon accepts, CLAUDE.md). The screen is drawn, with invented names. Facts checked 2026-09-24: iOS live on the App Store (Afghanistan storefront only, since 2026-09-21, app-store/metadata.md) and Android on Google Play (since 2026-08-28) — the generator prints both store names in the footer; safebeauty.web.app/get stays the one printed link and sends each phone to its own store. Salons are in Kabul only — no second city, no count. No promotion running. Every salon, name, price and time on a screen is the invented demo world from marketing/demo/ — nothing real.

fa.headline: شما تصمیم می‌گیرید کدام رزرو را قبول کنید
fa.body: هر رزرو اول به شما می‌رسد. قبول یا رد، با شماست.

ps.headline: تاسو پرېکړه کوئ کوم بکینګ ومنئ
ps.body: هر بکینګ لومړی تاسو ته راځي. منل یا ردول ستاسو په لاس کې دي.
